params.description: Specify the API key response page you want to fetch, starting with 0. If not set, the response will contain first page. The highest allowed page value is 100.

params.name: size
params.description: The number of API keys in one response page. If not set, the response will be limited to 100 API keys, which is also the highest allowed size.

params.name: orderBy
params.description: The ordering parameter of API keys in the response page. If not set, the API keys in the response will be ordered by API key id.

params.name: orderDirection
params.description: The order direction of API keys in the response page. If not set, the API keys in the response will be in the ascending order.

params.name: from
params.description: Date and time filter with the following format: `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ`. If nothing is provided, there will be no lower limit filter applied on a date and time of recorded activity returned in logs.

params.name: item
params.description: Use it as a filter to apply to the action field to narrow down the logs returned. if nothing is provided, logs with all items are returned.

params.name: ipAddress
params.description: User's IP address. If nothing is provided, logs for all IP addresses are returned.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max number of user activities returned in logs. Accepts values from `1` to `10000`. Defaults to `10000`.

params.name: to
params.description: Date and time filter with the following format: `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ`. If nothing is provided, there will be no upper limit filter applied on a date and time of recorded user activity returned in logs.

params.name: userKey
params.description: User's key can be found on the user's profile page at the Infobip portal. If nothing is provided, the logs for all user keys are returned.
